description: CaMa-Flood-GPU implements CaMa-Flood river and floodplain hydrodynamics with Python, PyTorch and Triton for GPU execution. Shengyu Kang and contributors publish the source and a versioned archive under Apache-2.0. It accepts CaMa-Flood network parameters and runoff forcing, with preprocessing examples that create parameter and mapping files. The implementation targets global river simulations, while spatial resolution and forcing intervals depend on the selected network and runoff products. It can support flood-hazard calculations and repeated infrastructure exposure scenarios. Source access is free, but compatible input datasets retain their own terms. A limitation is the development-oriented setup: the README expects knowledge of the original model, includes paths that users must edit, and notes that AMD GPU execution is untested. It also identifies version dependencies in the preprocessing stack. The related original CaMa-Flood model was already drafted by the first review, but did not cover this GPU repository. No GPU benchmarks, numerical-equivalence checks or model runs were performed.
